entries.title: Jeremiah 9:1
segments: ¶Oh, that my head were waters, And my eyes a fountain of tears, That I might weep day and night For the slain of the daughter of my people!

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:2
segments: Oh, that I had in the wilderness A lodging place for travelers; That I might leave my people, And go from them! For they [are] all adulterers, An assembly of treacherous men.

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:3
segments: "And [like] their bow they have bent their tongues [for] lies. They are not valiant for the truth on the earth. For they proceed from evil to evil, And they do not know Me," says the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:4
segments: "Everyone take heed to his neighbor, And do not trust any brother; For every brother will utterly supplant, And every neighbor will walk with slanderers.

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:5
segments: Everyone will deceive his neighbor, And will not speak the truth; They have taught their tongue to speak lies; They weary themselves to commit iniquity.

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:6
segments: Your dwelling place [is] in the midst of deceit; Through deceit they refuse to know Me," says the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:7
segments: Therefore thus says the LORD of hosts: "Behold, I will refine them and try them; For how shall I deal with the daughter of My people?

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:8
segments: Their tongue [is] an arrow shot out; It speaks deceit; [One] speaks peaceably to his neighbor with his mouth, But in his heart he lies in wait.

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:9
segments: Shall I not punish them for these [things]?" says the LORD. "Shall I not avenge Myself on such a nation as this?"

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:10
segments: I will take up a weeping and wailing for the mountains, And for the dwelling places of the wilderness a lamentation, Because they are burned up, So that no one can pass through; Nor can [men] hear the voice of the cattle. Both the birds of the heavens and the beasts have fled; They are gone.

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:11
segments: "I will make Jerusalem a heap of ruins, a den of jackals. I will make the cities of Judah desolate, without an inhabitant."

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:12
segments: ¶Who [is] the wise man who may understand this? And [who is he] to whom the mouth of the LORD has spoken, that he may declare it? Why does the land perish [and] burn up like a wilderness, so that no one can pass through?

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:13
segments: And the LORD said, "Because they have forsaken My law which I set before them, and have not obeyed My voice, nor walked according to it,

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:14
segments: "but they have walked according to the dictates of their own hearts and after the Baals, which their fathers taught them,"

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:15
segments: therefore thus says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: "Behold, I will feed them, this people, with wormwood, and give them water of gall to drink.

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:16
segments: "I will scatter them also among the Gentiles, whom neither they nor their fathers have known. And I will send a sword after them until I have consumed them."

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:17
segments: Thus says the LORD of hosts: "Consider and call for the mourning women, That they may come; And send for skillful wailing women, That they may come.

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:18
segments: Let them make haste And take up a wailing for us, That our eyes may run with tears, And our eyelids gush with water.

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:19
segments: For a voice of wailing is heard from Zion: 'How we are plundered! We are greatly ashamed, Because we have forsaken the land, Because we have been cast out of our dwellings.'"

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:20
segments: Yet hear the word of the LORD, O women, And let your ear receive the word of His mouth; Teach your daughters wailing, And everyone her neighbor a lamentation.

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:21
segments: For death has come through our windows, Has entered our palaces, To kill off the children-[no longer to be] outside! [And] the young men-[no longer] on the streets!

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:22
segments: Speak, "Thus says the LORD: 'Even the carcasses of men shall fall as refuse on the open field, Like cuttings after the harvester, And no one shall gather [them].'"

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:23
segments: ¶Thus says the LORD: "Let not the wise [man] glory in his wisdom, Let not the mighty [man] glory in his might, Nor let the rich [man] glory in his riches;

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:24
segments: But let him who glories glory in this, That he understands and knows Me, That I [am] the LORD, exercising lovingkindness, judgment, and righteousness in the earth. For in these I delight," says the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:25
segments: "Behold, the days are coming," says the LORD, "that I will punish all [who are] circumcised with the uncircumcised-

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:26
segments: "Egypt, Judah, Edom, the people of Ammon, Moab, and all [who are] in the farthest corners, who dwell in the wilderness. For all [these] nations [are] uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel [are] uncircumcised in the heart."
